name: dhakapool
description: Dhaka Tesla Pool — ride pooling and shared fares for Dhaka's three-wheeled Teslas

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @dhakapool/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @dhakapool/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
